# Temple Scroll Column 63 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 63 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**63:1** You shall surely investigate and inquire and ask diligently, and behold, the thing is true and certain — the abomination has been done in your midst —

**63:2** you shall surely put the inhabitants of that city to the mouth of the sword; you shall devote it to destruction, it and all that is in it and its livestock, with the mouth of the sword.

**63:3** And all its plunder you shall gather into the midst of its open square, and you shall burn with fire the city and all its plunder, all of it, before me.

**63:4** And it shall be a heap forever; it shall not be built again. And nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand,

**63:5** so that I may turn from the burning of my anger and give you compassion, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as I swore to your fathers,

**63:6** when you obey my voice, to keep all my commandments that I am commanding you this day, to do what is right in my sight.

**63:7** You shall not sacrifice to me an ox or a sheep in which there is a blemish, any evil defect, for it is an abomination to me.

**63:8** You shall not eat any abominable thing. These are the animals that you may eat: the ox, the sheep of the flock, and the goat,

**63:9** the deer and the gazelle and the roebuck and the wild goat and the ibex and the antelope and the mountain sheep.

**63:10** Every animal that parts the hoof and has the hoof cloven in two and chews the cud among the animals — that you may eat.

**63:11** You shall surely tithe all the yield of your seed that comes forth from the field year by year.

**63:12** And you shall eat before me, in the place that I shall choose to cause my name to dwell there, the tithe of your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil,

**63:13** and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock, so that you may learn to fear me all the days.

**63:14** And if the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, because the place that I shall choose to set my name there is too far from you,

**63:15** when I bless you, then you shall turn it into silver, and bind the silver in your hand, and go to the place that I shall choose.

**63:16** And you shall spend the silver on whatever your soul desires: on oxen or on sheep or on wine or on strong drink or on whatever your soul asks of you, and you shall eat there before me and rejoice, you and your household.

---

*EMET notes: Column 63 continues the apostate city law (completing Deut 13:12–18), then transitions to blemished sacrifices (Deut 17:1), clean/unclean animals (Deut 14:3–6), and tithes (Deut 14:22–26). "Mouth of the sword" preserves Hebrew לפי חרב literally. "Before me" replaces Deuteronomy's "before the LORD" — characteristic first-person divine speech. "Devote to destruction" for חרם maintained as technical term.*
